- **Sources:** Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. The public North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact. Marcus can see both.
- **Kept private:** I didn't use anything from Dana's direct messages.
- **gbrain still unavailable:** it refused the search again because its access token isn't tied to any member. To fix it, an admin on the brain host would need to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`.
